description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Barret to trigger.
Resolve Barret's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Rebel creature token plus an additional artifact token through Tippy-Toe, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl. Each relevant ability of Barret triggers.
Repeat from step 2.
